animationContract: Use inspected installed animation as the movement baseline. Preserve native joint performance. Only a specifically taught operation such as timing, mirroring, clip blending or hand scale may vary, with that variable named. Never build ad hoc humanoid movements to stand in for a stock performance. Explicit abstract diagrams remain available for FK/IK, rotation axes and surface deformation.
summaryContract: Exactly 600 frames at 60fps after the body and before the existing membership end. Narrated topic summary with relevant motion and no new coaching speech. Preserve source narration and the lesson order.
resourcePolicy: Discord encoder is active. CPU voice and isolated WARP captures until the existing GPU protection rules permit use. Costly jobs serialized.

observations: The four actual UE poses are visibly different: baseline stance, raised arms/weapon, target contact posture, and bent torso during follow-through. The current phase has a matching colored outline and label.

The enlarged analysis uses one scene instead of duplicated left/right scenes. Its resting/impact skeleton, current arm joints and hand path are separately visible; the subject and phase labels remain recognizable at 375 px.

The figure feet end above the phase strip; the foot-position marker is inside the scene. Fixed burned captions below the strip do not cover the pose, active-phase label or four-panel descriptions in the reviewed frames.
The impact sample displays active evaluation and conditional hit-stop separately from the pose label. These are marked as the authored demonstration rules, not measured commercial-game data.

The only retained paired view shows distinct behavior: the 48-frame version continues its attack pose while the 36-frame version has entered a real running animation. Its input thresholds are separately labeled.

Three native-pass samples visibly carry 1/3, 2/3 and 3/3 markers. Successive native/slow samples show stance, raised arms, contact, follow-through and return; the post-analysis sample returns to the retained independent gameplay.

episodes.recapKo: 준비로 알리고, 공격으로 힘을 펼친 뒤 후속 동작으로 정리합니다. 공격 판정과 다음 입력 시점도 함께 확인하세요.
episodes.recapEn: Signal with anticipation, deliver the attack, and settle with follow-through. Check hit detection and when the next input becomes available.

episodes.title: 빠르고 강한 준비 동작 | 공격의 준비 동작을 짧고 강하게 만드는 방법

baseline.description: 반복 관찰에 동작을 짚는 안내 음성을 추가했습니다.

cues.ko: 도끼를 내리치기 전에, 도끼가 먼저 위로 올라갑니다.
cues.en: Before the axe comes down, it rises overhead.
cues.readback: 도끼를 내리치기 전에 도끼가 먼저 위로 올라갑니다.

cues.ko: 시작하자마자 어깨와 팔이 얼마나 달라지는지 보세요.
cues.en: Watch how far the shoulder and arm move at the start.
cues.readback: 시작하자마자 어깨와 팔이 얼마나 달라지는지 보세요.

cues.ko: 기다리는 동안 팔을 몸 쪽으로 모으는 움직임을 보세요.
cues.en: Watch the arms gather toward the body during the wait.
cues.readback: 기다리는 동안 팔을 몸쪽으로 모으는 움직임을 보세요.

cues.ko: 공격 직전에 몸을 어떻게 준비하는지 보세요.
cues.en: Watch how the body sets up just before the attack.
cues.readback: 공격 직전에 몸을 어떻게 준비하는지 보세요

cues.ko: 주먹이 나가기 직전, 팔을 거두는 순간이 보이나요?
cues.en: Can you see the arm draw back just before the punch?
cues.readback: 주먹이 나가기 직전 팔을 거두는 순간이 보이나요?

cues.ko: 검이 올라간 뒤 몸이 내려치는 쪽으로 기웁니다.
cues.en: Once the sword rises, the body leans into the downward strike.
cues.readback: 검이 올라간 뒤 몸이 내려치는 쪽으로 기웁니다.

sampledVisualQa.observed: Six new observation captions appear at the relevant Hades, Smash and preparation studies. Clip labels and poses are visible at 375px.

episodes.recapKo: 준비 동작은 공격 방향과 힘을 미리 알려 줍니다. 첫 변화를 또렷하게 만들고, 필요한 시간만 남겨 보세요.
episodes.recapEn: Anticipation signals direction and force. Make the first change clear and keep the time the player needs to read it.

episodes.title: 공격 자세 | 같은 공격인데 왜 어떤 자세가 더 세게 느껴질까?

baseline.title: 공격 자세 | 같은 공격인데 왜 어떤 자세가 더 세게 느껴질까?

cues.readback: 어깨부터 손끝까지 높이가 어떻게 이어지는지 보세요.

cues.readback: 공격하는 팔과 균형을 잡는 팔을 따로 보세요

cues.ko: 같은 자세인데, 보는 각도에 따라 팔이 드러납니다.
cues.en: The pose is the same, but the angle reveals the arm.
cues.readback: 같은 자세인데 보는 각도에 따라 팔이 드러납니다.

cues.ko: 몸의 윤곽만 보고 공격 방향을 찾아보세요.

cues.readback: 몸의 윤곽만 보고 공격 방향을 찾아보세요.

episodes.recapEn: The striking arm and supporting body shape the pose together. Check direction, silhouette, and the form at impact.

episodes.title: 공격 이후의 후속 동작 | 공격이 끝난 뒤의 동작이 타격감을 만드는 이유

baseline.title: 피격 애니메이션 | 캐릭터는 맞았다는 사실을 어떻게 보여줄까?

cues.en: The right side spends longer preparing, then lifts the arm quickly.
cues.readback: 오른쪽은 준비의 시간을 쓰고 팔을 빠르게 올립니다.

cues.ko: 팔을 내밀 때와 거둘 때 손이 지나는 길을 보세요.

episodes.recapEn: Fingers show the object being held and the hand’s role. Prioritize visible hands and match detail to their screen size.

baseline.description: 반복 관찰에 동작을 짚는 안내 음성을 추가했습니다.

episodes.recapKo: 관절 회전만으로 모든 형태를 만들 수는 없습니다. 뼈대의 움직임과 표면 변형을 나눠 보고, 필요한 표현을 선택하세요.

episodes.recapKo: 고개와 손목은 한 축만 돌리면 기계적으로 보일 수 있습니다. 두 축의 타이밍을 나누고, 시선까지 함께 확인하세요.
episodes.recapEn: A head or wrist can look mechanical with one-axis rotation. Offset the timing on two axes and check the gaze as well.

narrationRevision: 34 demonstration-dependent sentences now align existing animation observation and explicit principle diagrams; source lesson order and all other useful speech remain.
recapRatioDecision: The requested recap adds exactly 600 explanatory frames per episode before the retained ending. Existing body game/explanation timing remains; no unrelated footage is padded to a quota. Prior body counts are retained only where the baseline supplies verified classifications; no unmeasured percentage is invented.

retainedA11Kick.sourcePerformance: ACCAD Male2 G20 Reverse Spin Crescent Right
retainedA11Kick.retentionReason: Already uses an actual recorded spinning-kick performance retargeted from its source joint landmarks; the comparison changes source-time allocation, without inventing an action. Preserve the requested spinning kick while replacing the separate hand-built uppercut with a directly bound native forward punch.
